trust_center.repositoryDescription:
Thinktrends AI Platform Trust Center
FedRAMP 20x Class C — Pursuing FedRAMP 20x
Authorization
Welcome to the Thinktrends AI Platform Trust Center — your
source of truth for our security and compliance posture under
the FedRAMP 20x program.
In line with FedRAMP 20x's Authorization Data Sharing (ADS)
requirements, this Trust Center provides continuously
updated, machine-readable evidence of our security controls,
rather than static point-in-time documentation. Here you'll
find:
Key Security Indicators (KSIs): Live status of our validated
security controls, updated automatically as our environment
changes
Authorization Package: Access to our System Security Plan
(SSP), OSCAL-formatted artifacts, and supporting
documentation for Thinktrends Ai Platform.
Continuous Monitoring: Real-time visibility into POA&Ms,
Significant Change Notifications (SCNs), and monthly
ConMon outputs
Service Scope: Description of the systems, boundaries, and
cloud environments covered under this authorization
Target Timeline: Thinktrends AI Platform expects to complete
FedRAMP 20x Class C authorization by Q4 2026.
Thinktrends AI Platform is committed to the FedRAMP 20x
model of continuous, verifiable compliance — treating security
as an ongoing engineering discipline rather than a periodic
paperwork exercise. Federal agencies and prospective
customers can reach out for more detail on our authorization
roadmap or to request early access to available materials via
fedramp-support@thinktrends.co.
For questions about our FedRAMP 20x authorization, reach
out to fedramp-support@thinktrends.co.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions:
Access to ThinkTrends AI Platform is managed through AWS
Cognito, providing secure, cloud-native identity and access
management for all users. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
is enforced at login, and Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC)
are applied at the platform level to ensure only authorized
personnel can access approved resources and workflows.

certified_services.serviceName: ThinkTrends The Enterprise Agentic AI Platform
certified_services.serviceDescription: ThinkTrends provides a fully managed, integrated Agentic AI and Data & Knowledge Platform for building, deploying, and operating intelligent AI agents and orchestrating enterprise data workflows. The platform combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), persistent memory, tool integrations, configurable safety guardrails, semantic search, vector-embedded document ingestion, managed Airflow-based ETL pipelines, and a visual Flow Builder for coordinating multi-step AI and data processes. Supporting conversational, task-based, and research-oriented agent configurations powered by Amazon foundation models, including Anthropic Claude, it enables agencies to securely ingest, process, index, retrieve, and act on structured and unstructured federal data at scale.

certified.useCase:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides the underlying cloud
infrastructure for ThinkTrends AI Platform, including
compute (Amazon EC2/ECS), storage (Amazon S3),
managed AI services, vector database (Amazon
OpenSearch / S3 Vectors), AWS RDS, workflow
orchestration (Amazon MWAA / Airflow), and identity/access
management (AWS IAM). AWS holds FedRAMP Moderate
authorization.

current.service_desc:
ThinkTrends AI Platform is a cloud-based, enterprise-grade
Agentic AI platform developed by ThinkTrends LLC. It
provides federal agencies and commercial organizations with
a unified environment for deploying, managing, and operating
AI-powered agents, knowledge bases, data pipelines, and
intelligent workflows. Key capabilities include:
- **AI Agent Studio**: Build and deploy conversational AI
agents with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), memory,
and tool integrations backed by Amazon foundation models.
- **Knowledge Base Management**: Ingest, index, and query
structured and unstructured documents using vector
embeddings for grounded, citation-based AI responses.
- **Agent Flow Orchestration**: Design and execute visual
node-based AI workflows for automated, multi-step tasks.
- **Data Pipelines**: Managed Agentic ETL-based pipelines
for data ingestion, transformation, and delivery.
- **Guardrails & Safety**: Configurable content safety
guardrails (HIPAA, PII, tone, compliance policies) applied at
the agent and platform level.
- **File & Drive Integration**: Secure file management
integrated with Google Drive and native cloud storage.
- **Enterprise Connectors**: Native integrations with Slack,
Jira, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and agency
enterprise systems.
- **Agentic Governance**: Ability to run automated evaluation
jobs, analyse agent responses against accuracy, relevance,
and safety benchmarks, and iteratively improve prompts
based on those scores
